overall_summary: After deduplicating 47 unique videos across September and October 2026, audience traction is heavily concentrated in visceral, high-stakes space exploration and 'What If You Fell Into...' immersive micro-survival scenarios. Videos utilizing direct hypothetical second-person hooks centered on lethal cosmic anomalies consistently breach 800 to 1,050+ views with top-tier like ratios (3.5%–4.0%), whereas generic psychology trivia, brain facts, and repeated audio-illusion topics floor out below 100 views and near-zero engagement.

winning_patterns.pattern: Second-Person Extreme Planetary Survival ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' generated 1,029 views and 38 likes; 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' hit 823 views; 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' achieved 972 views.
winning_patterns.action: Standardize the high-peril second-person framing ('What If You...') paired with extreme visual environments and sensory deconstructions of what happens to the human body.

winning_patterns.pattern: Bizarre Counter-Intuitive Cosmic Physics with Visceral Sensory Hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' achieved 981 views; 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' hit 1,030 views and 36 likes; 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' hit 723 views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus exoplanet and astrophysics concepts on sensory paradoxes (touch, pressure, optical extremes) presented in tightly paced 19-21 second runtimes.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated uploads of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' achieved between 5 and 53 views; 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' flopped at 38 views; song-stuck hooks generated 17 to 71 views.
weak_patterns.action: Halt standalone textbook cognitive psychology shorts unless restructured into dramatic mystery or forensic thriller case studies.

weak_patterns.pattern: Identical Topic Re-uploads Without Narrative Reinvention
weak_patterns.evidence: Reposting 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' collapsed from 220 views to 87 and then 34 views; duplicate 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' plateaued.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict deduplication; do not re-upload identical facts without changing the angle to a cinematic storytelling or survival scenario.

next_video.concept: What If You Drifted Onto a Rogue Planet (Nomad Worlds Free-Floating in Interstellar Space)?
next_video.opening_direction: Open instantly with a POV dropping through perpetual absolute-zero blackness: 'If you fell onto a rogue world wandering completely alone in the dark between galaxies, you wouldn't freeze instantly—you'd suffocate under liquid methane lakes.'
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that despite eternal pitch black and -350°F surface frost, radioactive geothermal hydrothermal vents beneath miles-thick ice sheets could sustain alien oceans warmer than Earth's.
next_video.reason: Leverages the proven high-retention 'What If You Fell Into' hook style while introducing an unvisited, highly visual cosmic topic (interstellar rogue planets like PSO J318.5-22 / wandering dark worlds) avoiding past repetitions of diamond/glass/burning ice exoplanets.
fresh_topic_constraints: Do not feature TrES-2b, 55 Cancri e, Gliese 436 b, WASP-76b, or diamond/ice planets.
Do not frame fiction as a confirmed sighting; ground rogue planet physics in genuine astronomical models.

experiment: Test testing sound design: integrate heavy sub-bass atmospheric droning and immersive first-person breathing sound effects in the first 3 seconds of the survival hook to evaluate if it boosts completion rate past 80%.
